notes.planFeature: If forwarding doesn't turn on, ask {{name}} to add call forwarding to your plan.
notes.iphone: On an iPhone, turn off Live Voicemail in your Phone settings. Otherwise it picks up before your receptionist can.
notes.ringTime: If you can pick a ring time, 15 to 20 seconds gives you about four rings before your receptionist answers.
notes.voicemail: If you have {{name}} voicemail, ask {{name}} to remove it. Missed calls can't forward while it's on.
notes.androidOnly: These steps are for Android phones. On an iPhone, ask {{name}} to turn it on for you.
notes.adminOnly: Only an admin of your {{name}} account can change this.
notes.verifyNumber: {{name}} sends a code to {{number}} before it forwards. Choose to get the code by phone call, then read it in that call's transcript under Calls.

test.all: To test it, call your business number from another phone. Your receptionist should answer.

unsupported.all: {{name}} doesn't list a way to forward all calls. Ask {{name}} to forward your calls to {{number}}.
